source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D212626 explicitly rejected camel case for the new localized message ID. Landed and current help IDs are menu-help-get-release-help/appmenu-help-get-release-help. DOM command keys retain releaseSupportURL and legacy menu_openReleaseHelp. Preserve each namespace instead of mechanically renaming every identifier to one case. This is supported for menu Fluent IDs, not proof of one universal DOM convention.
title: Use hyphenated Fluent message IDs within the menu localization family
